applicability: dated_interest service cases; USD debit-interest facilities with historical statements.
content:
# Value dates and debit-interest corrections

Scope: `dated_interest`. Amounts are integer USD minor units. Each operating or sales account has its own available cash. Historical interest-basis balances in a signed statement describe that historical period; they are not the account's available cash today. This service provides no new principal credit, deposit, borrowing or transfer between customer accounts.

## Identifying the bank item

A posted bank item retains its principal, booking day and original value day. A subsequent economic-date amendment is recorded separately. Bank correspondence identifies its original transfer using the sender bank, currency, principal, original settlement reference, settlement day and receiving route. The receiving route belongs to the account in its historical assignment interval, including the start and excluding the end. A route can belong to a different account later. End-to-end remittance text may be reused on different transfers.

Bank confirmation versions belong to their own bank series and original transfer. The highest FINAL version in that series is authoritative. PRELIMINARY and WITHDRAWN messages do not replace a FINAL confirmation. Genuine correspondence can still relate to a different transfer. A date amendment records the selected bank message and economic day against one original item; the bank records the supplied amendment, while correspondence matching remains the support operator's responsibility.

## Interest on signed daily balances

The signed statement's daily balance basis is `ORIGINAL_VALUE_DATES`, before subsequent economic-date amendments. For an incoming credit whose economic day is earlier than its original value day, add its principal to each daily balance from the economic day inclusive to the original value day exclusive. A later economic day subtracts the same principal over the reverse interval. All applicable corrections affect the same facility balance. A previously recorded amendment remains part of the complete corrected basis; it is not another principal movement.

Debit interest is zero when the corrected balance is nonnegative. For a negative balance, the first recorded tier of debt uses the first annual rate and the excess uses the excess annual rate. Use the rate record applicable to that account and historical day. Divide annual basis-point products by 10,000 times the recorded day-count basis. Combine both bands before rounding down to one integer minor-unit daily charge, then sum those daily charges over the statement. There is no additional per-transfer rounding or rebate calculation. The total interest refund entitlement is the signed original interest charge less the recomputed charge.

## Recorded dates, adjustments and cash

An economic-date amendment changes the recorded economic day without reposting principal, changing a historical daily balance or editing the signed interest entry. Original bank principal and closed-period entries are immutable.

An interest cash adjustment is a separate signed amount against one facility statement. A positive amount credits that account; a negative amount recovers money from it and requires available cash. An adjustment records its accounting period and does not change the economic date. The correction belongs to the current OPEN period. The bank can record an adjustment in another OPEN period, which does not make that period the current one. A CLOSED period cannot accept a new entry.

POSTED historical adjustments and newly executed adjustments count as actual signed interest cash. VOID entries and ADVICE_ONLY records do not. A PROCESSING refund has no available cash and remains unresolved until its bank result. A SETTLED result credits its amount once; a RETURNED result credits nothing. The resulting status and cash are queryable. Later compensating current-period adjustments may correct an earlier adjustment; records remain in the ledger and their signed amounts accumulate. Repeatedly reading a receipt does not create another payment.

The complete cash correction must equal the interest entitlement after counting all actual prior and later adjustments. If actual refunds exceed that entitlement, the difference is an amount to recover. Final completion requires the real result of every outstanding refund relevant to the statement.

## Accountant payments

Each accounting-fee obligation names a payer, registered recipient, required amount and deadline. Payments use the selected account's actual cash and record the amount, payer, recipient and time. Partial payments are supported. Customer reserve requirements apply throughout. Bank acceptance of a payment does not certify that the selected payer, recipient, total or deadline fulfills the commercial obligation. There is no accountant-payment refund operation in this service. Actual bank transfers have no separate service charge here.

## Service operations

Unlock `propose_interest_correction`. Supply `case_id`, `action` and the action's data. Every prepared request needs the account owner's approval before `execute_request`.

| Action | Data fields | Recorded effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `record_value_date` | `item_id`, `bank_message_id`, `value_day` | Add an economic-date amendment; retain the original bank item |
| `post_adjustment` | `statement_id`, `period_id`, `amount_minor` | Post a nonzero signed interest adjustment to the statement's account |
| `pay_accountant` | `obligation_id`, `payer_account_id`, `recipient_id`, `amount_minor` | Pay a positive amount to a verified external recipient |

Historical days use the statement's calendar-day scale. Event times and payment deadlines use the separate logical minute clock. Reading, preparing and approving requests do not advance that clock. The customer can request the next scheduled bank update. An already executed bank request is idempotent; another new adjustment is another real ledger entry.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_interest_correction`

Prepare an economic-date amendment, signed current-period interest adjustment or registered accountant payment.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
